args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, widening the gap between spot and contract pricing.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, introducing near-term volatility into freight cost planning.
- Per the companion analysis, shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least overall.
args.title: Tamarack Freight Blog: Combined Summary (Main Post + Companion)
